capabilities: Estimate recall probability per note with an Ebbinghaus exponential decay model
Display a color-coded memory-health dashboard with clickable status cards that open contributing notes
Estimate per-note review time using a default complexity with manual per-note override
Reinforce note stability through a review action
Preview how complexity settings change review time in a live settings example
disambiguation: Not a link-graph view; the map shows memory health of notes, not connections between them.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README labels the current feature set an MVP, so scope may still change.
problem: Obsidian tracks links and tags but has no built-in way to see which notes are fading from memory or when to review them.
summary: Spaced-repetition dashboard that estimates each note's recall probability with an Ebbinghaus decay model and prompts reviews of fading notes.
